title: Virginia Beach Scavenger Hunt Walking Activity
blurb: Discover the vibrant charm of Virginia Beach on a self-guided scavenger hunt that blends adventure with local history. This interactive journey takes you along the picturesque boardwalk, allowing you to uncover local legends and snap photos with the stunning backdrop of sand and surf. Engage your team as you explore iconic spots like Neptune Park and the Virginia Beach Oceanfront Fishing Pier while solving intriguing puzzles that reveal the area’s secrets. Perfect for families, friends, or a solo outing, this flexible experience lets you wander at your own pace—no reservations required.
